acceptance_criteria: `profiles(&Sketch, &ProfileOptions) -> Result<Vec<Region>, ProfileError>`. Each `Region` has an `outer: Loop` and `holes: Vec<Loop>`. A `Loop` is an ordered list of oriented edges (entity id plus direction), and has a signed area.
Rectangle 40 × 25 from 4 lines whose shared endpoints differ by ≤ 1e-9: 1 region, 4 edges, 0 holes, area 1000 ± 1e-9, counter-clockwise (positive signed area).
Rectangle 40 × 25 plus a circle of radius 5 at (20, 12.5): 1 region with 1 hole, region area 1000 − 25π ± 1e-9. The hole loop is clockwise.
Slot (2 lines + 2 semicircular arcs, radius 5, centers 30 apart): 1 region, area 30·10 + 25π ± 1e-9 (arc areas use the exact segment formula, not a polyline).
Two separate rectangles: 2 regions. A rectangle inside a circle inside a larger rectangle: depth-alternating nesting, giving 2 regions (outer rect minus circle; inner rect).

Open geometry (an L of 2 lines; a line with a dangling end attached to a closed loop) does not panic. Dangling edges are ignored and reported in a `ProfileReport::open_edges` list (or equivalent). A sketch with no closed loop returns an empty region list, not an error.

Point entities are ignored. Overlapping or self-intersecting edges (two crossing lines inside a loop) return `ProfileError::SelfIntersecting` (or equivalent) rather than a wrong region. Intersection splitting is out of scope.
No `unsafe`; no new dependencies; `swx-sketch` still doesn't depend on `swx-kernel`; doc comments cite the face-traversal and area formulas.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-06: Profile extraction: closed loops → regions with holes, ready for the kernel
